### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized). Background is dimmed (modal overlay).
*   **Modal Dialog (Center):** Approx. bounds [184, 140, 800, 690]. Centered horizontally and vertically. White background, rounded corners (approx. 8px radius), drop shadow.
*   **Dialog Header:**
    *   **Close Button ('X'):** Top-right corner [768, 168, 784, 184].
    *   **Icon Area:** Left side [226, 220, 280, 320]. Contains a blue hourglass icon.
    *   **Title Area:** Right of icon [316, 216, 600, 242].
    *   **Body Text Area:** Below title [316, 266, 752, 342]. Wraps to ~3 lines.
*   **Sub-header/Context:** [216, 366, 524, 388].
*   **Action Grid (Upsell/Retention):**
    *   **Row 1 (Price):** [216, 412, 768, 472]. Light purple/lavender background. Text left, CTA button right.
    *   **Row 2 (Service):** [216, 504, 768, 564]. White background with light border. Text left, CTA button right.
    *   **Row 3 (Quit):** [216, 596, 768, 656]. White background with light border. Text left, CTA button right.
*   **Background App (Visible behind overlay):**
    *   **Top Bar:** [0, 0, 1024, 52] (Title, Buy Now, Window controls).
    *   **Toolbar:** [0, 60, 1024, 115] (Nav breadcrumbs, View toggles, Search).
    *   **Sidebar (Left):** [0, 130, 180, 830] (Path dropdown, Tree view: Windows C:, File Path Lost, Reconstructed).
    *   **Main Content (Right):** [190, 130, 1024, 830] (File list: 'ghcup' folder preview, details pane, file list table).
    *   **Status Bar (Bottom):** [0, 850, 1024, 940] (Scan status left, 'Recover All' button right).

### 2) TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Window Title:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Button (Top):** "Buy Now"
*   **Search Placeholder:** "Search files or folders"
*   **Sidebar:** "Path", "Windows (C:)", "File Path Lost", "Reconstructed"
*   **Preview Pane:** "ghcup", "Open", "Size", "4.23 GB", "Date Modified", "10/8/2026 12:32 AM", "Path", "C:\"
*   **File List:** "Julia", "10/7/2026 11:21 PM", "File folder", "mingw32", "2/19/2026 12:59 PM", "File folder"
*   **Status Bar:** "Scan Completed, Files Found: **1139165** (146.58 GB)", "Recover All ..."
*   **Dialog Title:** "**Wait! You are at risk of losing data!**"
*   **Dialog Body:** "**1139165** files (**146.58 GB**) have been found.More than 50% of permanent data loss occurs because unrecovered files get overwritten by continued computer use."
*   **Dialog Subhead:** "Take the final step now to safely secure your data."
*   **Row 1 Text:** "Price too high?"
*   **Row 1 Button:** "Get Up to 40% Off"
*   **Row 2 Text:** "Can't find your lost data?"
*   **Row 2 Button:** "Online Service"
*   **Row 3 Text:** "Really want to quit?"
*   **Row 3 Button:** "Quit"

### 3) COLOR
*   **Modal Overlay (Background):** `#000000` at ~40-50% opacity (darkening the app behind).
*   **Dialog Surface:** `#FFFFFF`.
*   **Primary Accent (Blue):** `#3B82F6` (Used for links, icons, primary buttons like 'Recover All', 'Online Service').
*   **Warning/Accent (Orange):** `#F59E0B` (Used for 'Get Up to 40% Off' button background).
*   **Row 1 Background (Lavender):** `#F3E8FF` or `#EDE9FE`.
*   **Row Borders/Lines:** `#E5E7EB` (Light gray).
*   **Text Primary:** `#111827` (Near black).
*   **Text Secondary:** `#4B5563` (Dark gray).
*   **Text Link/Blue:** `#2563EB`.

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Dialog Title:** Sans-serif (likely Segoe UI/Inter), ~16-18px, **Bold**.
*   **Dialog Body:** Sans-serif, ~13-14px, Regular. Line height ~1.5.
*   **Row Labels ("Price too high?", etc.):** Sans-serif, ~14-15px, Regular/Dark.
*   **Buttons:** Sans-serif, ~13-14px, Medium/Bold.
*   **App Header:** ~14px, Regular.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Dialog Width:** ~616px.
*   **Dialog Padding:** ~24px internal padding.
*   **Row Height (Action Rows):** ~60px.
*   **Button Height:** ~36-40px.
*   **Border Radius (Dialog):** ~8px.
*   **Border Radius (Buttons):** ~4-6px.
*   **Gutter (between rows):** ~20px.
*   **Icon Size (Hourglass):** ~64x64px container, icon ~48x48px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Modal:** Visible, blocking interaction with parent window.
*   **Close Button ('X'):** Normal state.
*   **Buttons:**
    *   "Get Up to 40% Off": Normal (Enabled), Orange background.
    *   "Online Service": Normal (Enabled), Light Blue outline/background.
    *   "Quit": Normal (Enabled), Light Blue outline/background.
*   **Background Controls (Disabled visually by overlay):**
    *   "Recover All ...": Blue button, appears Enabled but obscured.
    *   Checkboxes in file list: Unchecked.
    *   Tree nodes: Expanded/Collapsed states visible.

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, filled or dual-tone (blue gradients).
*   **Hourglass Icon:** Blue gradient (`#60A5FA` to `#2563EB`), sand visible inside.
*   **App Icons:**
    *   Folder icons (Yellow/Blue).
    *   Checkmark circle (Green/Blue) in status bar.
    *   Mascot/Avatar (bottom right): Circular, colorful character.

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Retention / Upsell Gate (Interrupt)**.
*   **Context:** The user has completed a scan (Success state in background: "Scan Completed") and is attempting to close the application or proceed, triggering this modal to prevent data loss (or encourage purchase/service).
*   **Motion Cues:** None static in image, but the copy implies urgency ("Wait!", "risk of losing").
